{{Quote|Calling any Republic ships near the Corbantis system. This an emergency... Any Republic forces near the Corbantis system, respond immediately!|[[Advisor/Legends|Clone advisor]] [[01/425]], during the [[mission to the Chaykin Cluster]]|<ref name="RC" />}}
The '''Corbantis system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Chaykin Cluster]].<ref name="RC" />

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was located in the outskirts of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.<ref name="RC" />

The system was the site of a [[Mission to the Chaykin Cluster|skirmish]] between several [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. This skirmish included the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|assault ship]] ''[[Prosecutor]]'', which had been taken by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] (with the help of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Salvage droid/Legends|scavenger droids]]) with the loss of all hands including Captain [[Martz]]. The ship was recovered by [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad's]] [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] but it was soon attacked by a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ship]]. The battle later included the ''Acclamator''-class assault ship [[Arrestor (Acclamator-class)|''Arrestor'']] which helped to destroy the ''Lucrehulk''-class while Delta regained the operational use of ''Prosecutor''{{'s}} automated [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] batteries.<ref name="RC" />
